title: XDoGE: Multilingual Data Reweighting to Enhance Language Inclusivity in LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model perplexity and zero/few-shot downstream task performance using the IberoBench framework across high-, mid-, and low-resource languages (English, Spanish, Portuguese, Catalan, Basque, Galician) to assess disparities in linguistic inclusivity and cross-lingual transfer capabilities.
